item.title: Tiny Violins At The Ready, Pokémon Scalpers Are Upset About New Expansion's Profitability

description.p: Boo hoo.The Pokémon Trading Card Game 30th Anniversary expansion launched last week on 16th September, and the release was expectedly messy.
